title: SmartInventoryRecall
description: Server-side mod that saves your inventory layout on death and automatically restores items to their original slots when picked up. Vanilla client compatible!
body:
# Smart Inventory Recall

**Never lose your inventory organization again!**

Smart Inventory Recall is a server-side mod that automatically saves your inventory layout when you die and restores items to their original slots when you pick them up.

##  Features

- **Automatic Inventory Snapshot** - Your inventory layout is saved before death
- **Compact Item Drops** - Items drop within a 2-block radius instead of scattering everywhere
- **Smart Auto-Restore** - Items automatically return to their original slots as you pick them up
- **5-Minute Timer** - You have 5 minutes to recover your items before the snapshot expires
- **Server-Side Only** - No client mod required! Works on vanilla clients

【このModの特徴】

整理の手間ゼロ: 拾ったアイテムが自動的に元のスロットに戻ります。

アイテムが散らばらない: 死亡地点の半径2ブロック以内に固まってドロップします。

導入が簡単: サーバー側にのみ導入すればOK。遊ぶ人はバニラのままで大丈夫です。~~~~

##  How It Works

1. You die with items in your inventory
2. The mod saves a snapshot of which item was in which slot
3. Your items drop in a compact area (2-block radius)
4. When you pick up items, they automatically move to their original slots
5. Your inventory organization is restored!

## 📋Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.11**
- Fabric Loader **0.18.4+**
- Fabric API

##  Perfect For

- Survival servers where organization matters
- Hardcore servers where death is costly
- Any server where players value their inventory layouts


##  Found a Bug?

Report issues on [GitHub](https://github.com/Misemise8/SmartInventoryRecall/issues)
